name: Toxic Scabbard
body:
Price 6,000 gp; Slot none; CL 3rd; Weight — Aura faint necromancy

DESCRIPTION

This subtle, unremarkable leather sheath is a poisoner’s delight. It can accommodate any weapon from the light blade weapon group, and if the wielder places a dose of injury or contact poison into the toxic scabbard, it retains its potency indefinitely until used. The enchantment of the toxic scabbard and any weapon sheathed in it or poison contained within it cannot be detected with divinatory magic unless the caster succeeds on a DC 20 caster level check. As a swift action, the wearer can coat a weapon sheathed in the toxic scabbard with the stored poison; he has no chance of accidentally poisoning himself when doing so. In addition, the wielder may choose to spread the dose of the poison out by not applying a full dose, allowing him to poison his weapon more than once. He must make this choice when triggering the stored poison for the first time. If he chooses to split the poison into two doses, the save DC for each dose is reduced by 2. If he splits the poison into three doses, the save DC for each dose is reduced by 4. A character with at least 5 ranks in Craft (alchemy) and has the poison use class feature can use a toxic scabbard to even greater effect, storing one additional dose of poison in the scabbard for every 5 ranks he has in Craft (alchemy). He can store multiple doses of the same poison or doses of different poisons, and can choose which poison to activate. If he did not place the poisons in the scabbard, he can identify which poisons are stored with a successful DC 20 Craft (alchemy) check. If multiple doses of the same poison are stored, he can trigger multiple doses at once; for each dose after the first, the save DC is increased by 2.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 3,000 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item, Craft (alchemy) 5 ranks; Spells nondetection, poison
